main.description: Bookmark a private-tier post for the requester. The bookmark is the requester's state on this AppView, not a repository record. The post is not looked up: the answer is the same whether or not it exists or the requester may read it, and getBookmarks shows it only while the requester may read it. Idempotent: a repeat replaces the stored cid and keeps the bookmark's place. Private bookmarks have their own limit, separate from app.bsky.bookmark's. Requires auth by a ready community member.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The URI is not a tools.kryphocron.feed.postPrivate record URI, or the requester's bookmark limit is reached ('bookmark limit reached').

errors.name: NotEnrolled
errors.description: The caller is not a community member of this AppView.

errors.name: NotReady
errors.description: The caller's account indexing is still in progress.
